task.title: REST or gRPC for an internal service

nodes.title: For a high-frequency small-message internal path, gRPC beats REST/JSON on latency and bandwidth
REST's debuggability / caching ecosystem is easier on the edge-gateway side
nodes.falsification: If the team already has a gRPC observability toolchain, this edge disappears; the current toolchain is HTTP-centric, so it remains a tradeoff.

nodes.title: gRPC client maturity for the target languages isn't verified
nodes.needs: Check gRPC codegen / reconnection / interceptor support for the languages actually in use.

outcome.label: Recommendation · Grounded
outcome.text: Recommend gRPC for high-frequency internal paths; REST can stay for the external edge.
